description: A version range the adapter can satisfy: it negotiates 1, declares a manifest that claims live retrieval and as_of none, and answers a health probe. Health is a td info probe plus the workspace listing, so the record count, the coverage, and the watermark all come from the workspace rather than from the fact that a command returned. The diagnostics report the configured workspace name and the project td itself resolved side by side — here they differ, because the recording was captured from a workspace named tdfix and the case configures the name recall — so a location pointing somewhere unexpected is visible rather than silent.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
